entities.summary: Igli Hasani is an Albanian high-ranking diplomat and security expert. He served as the Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Albania in the government of Prime Minister Edi Rama from September 2023 until September 2025. Since September 2025, he has been serving as the Chairman of the Parliamentary Committee on Europe and Foreign Affairs
